name: Wahoo Steak
desc: A thick steak from a wahoo, a fast, striped fish that the Ascension anglers are famous for catching offshore. Grilled with lime. Restores 150 HP.

name: Dampier's Drip
desc: Cool, clean water from the spring on Green Mountain that kept William Dampier's shipwrecked crew alive in 1701. Restores 90 HP.

name: Turtle Tag
desc: A numbered flipper tag of the sort fitted to green turtles on Ascension's beaches. Conservation staff follow each tagged turtle for decades, long after it has swum 2,000 kilometres to Brazil and back.
msg: {name}'s Turtle Tag shone in the surf!
